source.title: Wikipedia: Newcomen atmospheric engine
source.gives: First documented engine 1712 at Conygree, Tipton (Dudley Castle engine, drawn 1719); steam at no more than 1-2 psi; copper boiler with lead dome, brass then cast-iron cylinders (Hawarden c. 1714-15); replica cylinder 52 cm bore, over 2 m long; Savery 1698, Papin 1690; fuel-hungry; horsepower not given (open)
